title: feat(nm2splt2y): 1-in 2-out at t vs t+1 on two-axis opposite y-probes: reverse fail then HOLD, face fails, composition fail
science: Split t vs t+1 on opposite y-probes: fail everywhere at t, HOLD at A,B,C and fail at D at t+1 (D is 1-in-1-out, union misses e_2). Composition fail. Notes that frozen-M composition HOLDs on the same cut while split composition fails - the one clean separation between M-freeze and split-freeze.
